Rumors about the next-generation Apple TV 4K have consistently suggested it will feature a more modern chip to support Apple Intelligence features. However, the latest leak discovered by Aaron Perris indicates that its chip will be even more powerful than expected.

Code leak shows Apple TV 4K will feature A19 or A19 Pro chip

We've been waiting for a new Apple TV 4K for a long time — longer than any period in the product's history.

There were originally rumors that the new model would launch in 2025, with evidence pointing to an A17 Pro chip. That chip is currently the minimum requirement to support Apple Intelligence, suggesting a substantial upgrade over the existing A15 Bionic.

However, according to Aaron Perris, the chip in the new Apple TV 4K will be even more powerful than expected. He wrote:

We've discovered a code reference corresponding to Apple's next-generation Apple TV model, AppleTV18,1.

The most upvoted comment was posted by razmsu

I just want the remote to make a sound when I'm looking for it. That's it. Please.

The "18,1" numbering convention is consistent with Apple's iPhone 17 lineup naming from last year. Some iPhone 17 models feature the A19 chip, while the iPhone Air and 17 Pro series use the A19 Pro.

Whether it's the A19 or A19 Pro, it would be a significant upgrade for the Apple TV. However, I think the A19 Pro is more likely, as only it would exclusively support the most advanced Siri AI features.

Siri AI is expected to be one of the key new features of the new Apple TV 4K. Given how long the hardware refresh has been delayed, hopefully Apple won't hold back any AI features when the new model launches.

Are you planning to buy the new Apple TV 4K? Let us know in the comments.
